_note: Prologue, the storm night over Brindlewick (plan item 1410). Starts over black.

say: Veydal. A valley of lakes and terraces, drawn and redrawn by its cartographers.
Last night a storm tore the sky open above the lake.
Where the lightning struck, Rifts opened, and the Spirlings near them fell silent.
Three small lights crossed the lake in the storm, following the lighthouse lamp.
In the Brindlewick lighthouse, an apprentice cartographer is still asleep...
